info.title: Legacy 3.0 Keywords
info.description: A 3.1 document that still carries the 3.0-era `nullable` flag and boolean `exclusiveMaximum`/`exclusiveMinimum`. Neither is valid in 3.1, but real-world specs are often converted from 3.0 without rewriting them, so the parser accepts both. The conformant 3.1 spellings live in kitchen-sink.json.
